mmorpg.jei.prof.grid: 3x2 grid: one slot holds the gear, the rest hold ingredients. Adjacent slots get a stat bonus.

mmorpg.jei.prof.result_consumable: Result: a consumable with the ingredient stats.

mmorpg.jei.gem.socket: Drag onto gear that has an empty socket.

mmorpg.jei.info.ingredient: Profession ingredient: adds stats to gear or consumables.

mmorpg.jei.backpack.apply: Drag the upgrade onto a backpack in your inventory.
mmorpg.jei.backpack.limit: A backpack can hold at most %s upgrades.

mmorpg.jei.info.rune_unused: This rune is not used in any runeword.
mmorpg.jei.newbie.contents: Default contents: a plain iron staff and a level 1 common staff soul.
mmorpg.jei.newbie.open: Right-click to open the starter gear bag.

mmorpg.jei.producer.tier: The soul is created at your level with a random starting rarity.

mmorpg.jei.prof.tool: %s tool: right-click it to open the crafting grid.

mmorpg.jei.rarity.preserve: The stone is consumed and the gear moves to the next rarity.

mmorpg.jei.salvage.soul: Salvage a stat soul without applying it.

mmorpg.jei.world.currency: World loot can generate currency orbs directly.

mmorpg.jei.world.gear_souls: World loot generates unidentified stat souls.

mmorpg.jei.world.ingredients: World loot can generate profession ingredients.

mmorpg.jei.world.rune_crates: Rune world loot drops as rune crates, not loose runes.

mmorpg.word.alchemydesc: Combine the alchemist's mortar with ingredients to produce potions. Potions have strong but short effects.
mmorpg.word.armorcraftingdesc: Combine an Armorer's Cloth with a piece of armor and some materials to enchant that item with stats.
mmorpg.word.blacksmithdesc: Blacksmithing turns stones and minerals into useful tools.
mmorpg.word.cantusemoreof: Can't use more than 1 ingredient of that type.
mmorpg.word.cookingdesc: Combine the Cook's pot with ingredients to produce foods. Food has a long lasting effect.
mmorpg.word.corruptedexplanation1: Use Orb of Purification to clear corruption.
mmorpg.word.corruptedexplanation2: Item won't provide any stats until purified.
mmorpg.word.explorationdesc: Exploration is all about treasure finding! Looting chests out in the world gives not only loot and favor, but also exploration experience. Completing minecraft advancements also rewards experience.
mmorpg.word.failedbutsafe: Upgrade failed but the Protection Scroll effect safeguarded the item.
mmorpg.word.farmingdesc: Farming is the process of turning purified essence into edible crops. These crops can then be used for alchemy or cooking.
mmorpg.word.fishingdesc: Fishing is the simplest profession. You catch fish and get experience. Sometimes you might get important materials like ink, which is used in other professions. You can also catch different fish in different biomes.
mmorpg.word.gearhasdata: The used gear has stats already
mmorpg.word.holdtopreventpickup: Hold in your hand to prevent item pickup.
mmorpg.word.inscribingdesc: Combine the Scribe's Fabric with ingredients to produce scrolls. Scrolls buff everyone around you for a short duration.
mmorpg.word.jewelcraftingdesc: Combine a Jeweler's Tool with a ring or necklace and some materials to enchant that item with stats.
mmorpg.word.miningdesc: Mining is one of the basic gatherer professions. You gain experience for mining ores and smelting them. When mining ores, there's a small chance Mystical Stones pop up. They have various uses.
mmorpg.word.mustbespellgem: Must be a Spell Gem Item
mmorpg.word.nogear: This recipe requires gear as ingredient
mmorpg.word.passivedesc: Casted when hit by mob at low health.
mmorpg.word.repairkit2: Craft with fuel mat to charge.
mmorpg.word.rightclicktoidentifyfirst: Use to identify first item in inventory.
mmorpg.word.rightclicktoteleport: Use to teleport back from Adventure Map.
mmorpg.word.salvagingdesc: Salvaging is about turning useless gear into essence, a material that's useful for many things.
mmorpg.word.savesnamedorenchanted: Doesn't auto salvage named or enchanted items.
mmorpg.word.socketlvlisnthigherthaniteml: Socket lvl not higher than gear lvl
mmorpg.word.stormcloudspelldesc: Summons a storm cloud that deals damage over time.
mmorpg.word.useanidentifyscroll: An Identify Scroll can reveal it.
mmorpg.word.weaponcraftingdesc: Combine a Weapon Crafter's Hammer with a weapon and some materials to enchant that item with stats.
mmorpg.word.wrongingredient: You can't use use that item in this recipe.
mmorpg.word.wrongrecipeingredient: That ingredient isn't usable in this profession.

mmorpg.tips.favor: You gain favor when opening chests found in structures for the first time. Favor is expended when you gain loot. At zero favor, you can't obtain great loot and your experience gain is lowered!
mmorpg.tips.foodtoregen: You won't regenerate health or mana if your hunger bar is low.
mmorpg.tips.proffslvling: There are many professions and leveling them provide benefits, including bonus experience when killing mobs!
mmorpg.tips.proffwiki: Most professions have wiki sections, like what ores reward mining experience! Check it in the profession screen!
mmorpg.tips.wiki: There is an in-game wiki! It shows useful things like what unique gears exist, how to get them, what level mobs are in which dimensions and so on! Go check it out in the Main Hub! (Default key: H)

item.mmorpg.currency.legendary_safe_scro: Blesses the gear, not allowing upgrades to destroy gear
item.mmorpg.currency.number_reroll.desc: Re-rolls explicit numbers on a gear.
item.mmorpg.currency.orb_of_infinity.des: Resets the gear's upgrade level and rerolls slots.
item.mmorpg.currency.orb_of_transmutatio: Transform common item into higher rarity.

mmorpg.item.desc.family.gem:
A gem for gear sockets.
How to use: drag it onto a piece of gear in your inventory — it fills one empty socket.
The gear needs a free socket and must not already have a gem of the same type.
Upgrading: use 3 identical gems at once — the chance is listed on the gem.
On success you get the next rank gem, on failure all 3 gems are destroyed.
The highest rank gem cannot be upgraded.
mmorpg.item.desc.family.rune:
A rune for the Runeword Station.
It does nothing on its own.
The station has 6 rune slots: put in an item and the runes whose set exactly matches a runeword recipe.
Runes drop from mobs and rewards, their value depends on the rune type.
mmorpg.item.desc.family.ingredient:
A profession ingredient.
It goes into the crafting grid (6 slots, 3x2) together with the profession tool.
The ingredient's stats are transferred to the result, so the higher its tier, the stronger the outcome.
Every ingredient has its own list of professions — other professions reject it.
Some ingredients affect adjacent grid slots: read their own description (Alt).
Only one "artifact" ingredient (marked "Only one of") can be used per craft.
mmorpg.item.desc.family.smelted_essence:
Smelted essence.
Made by smelting purified essence (dust) in a furnace or at a station.
A profession material: used for condensed essence and gear recipes.
Its tier matches the tier of the source dust.
mmorpg.item.desc.family.condensed_essenc:
Condensed essence.
Crafted from 3 smelted essences of the same tier.
A profession material: used in upgrade and currency recipes.
Its tier decides which recipes it fits.
mmorpg.item.desc.family.mining_stone:
A mystical stone.
Sometimes appears when mining ore.
A profession material: used to craft tools and gear.
Its tier depends on the ore that was mined.
mmorpg.item.desc.family.salvage_dust:
Purified essence.
Repair: pick the essence up with the cursor and click damaged gear in your inventory.
Restores the durability listed in the tooltip; if the gear tier is higher than the essence tier, the repair is 5 times weaker.
A profession material: it is smelted into essence and used for scroll paper.
4 essences of a lower tier combine into 1 essence of the next tier.
mmorpg.item.desc.family.craft_tool:
A profession tool.
Right click to open this profession's crafting menu.
Put ingredients into the grid; gear professions also require a matching piece of gear.
The tool is not consumed.
mmorpg.item.desc.family.backpack:
An adventurer's backpack.
Right click to open its inventory.
Upgrades are installed by dragging them onto the backpack.
Items picked up by upgrades go straight inside.
mmorpg.item.desc.family.material_pouch:
A pouch for profession materials.
Right click to open.
It stores ingredients, essences and stones.
mmorpg.item.desc.family.backpack_upgrade:
A backpack upgrade.
Drag it onto a backpack in your inventory to install it.
Each upgrade is installed once and works permanently.
The upgrade tier decides which backpack it fits.
mmorpg.item.desc.family.stat_soul:
A gear soul.
It holds a statted gear blueprint.
How to use: drag the soul onto empty gear.
The soul type must match the gear slot (if a slot is specified).
A soul with gear inside can be identified with an Identify Tome.
mmorpg.item.desc.family.crafted_consumab:
A profession crafting result.
Its stats depend on the ingredients used.
Food lasts long, potions are stronger but shorter, scrolls buff nearby allies.
mmorpg.item.desc.family.alchemy_potion:
An alchemy potion.
Right click to drink: restores health or mana depending on the type.
The restore amount is a percentage of your maximum.
It is brewed from ingredients, so its power depends on them.
mmorpg.item.desc.family.currency:
Gear currency.
How to use: drag it onto a piece of gear in your inventory.
Shift shows requirements, instability and the chance to break the item.
Every use adds instability; when the bar is full the item can no longer be modified.
Purification orbs reduce instability.
mmorpg.item.desc.family.loot_crate:
A reward crate.
Right click to open and take the contents.
The crate tier decides the reward level.
mmorpg.item.desc.family.tiered:
A profession and crafting material.
Used in gear, tool and currency recipes.
The item tier affects the result's power.
mmorpg.item.desc.family.block:
A mod block.
Place it in the world and right click it to use.
mmorpg.item.desc.common_soul_produce:
Right click to create a common gear soul.
The soul gets the tier of your level and fits any slot.
Consumes 1 item.
mmorpg.item.desc.identify_tome:
Right click to identify gear souls in your inventory.
Every soul without stats becomes a ready piece of gear.
One tome is spent per soul.
Souls that already have stats are left alone.
mmorpg.item.desc.loot_crate.default:
A reward crate.
Right click to open.
The contents depend on the crate tier.
mmorpg.item.desc.source_of_strength:
A crafting material.
Needed to craft upgrade stones, for example the magic upgrade stone (9 pcs).
Obtained by salvaging rarity essences.
mmorpg.item.desc.projectile.fireball:
A service projectile of the fire school.
Never given to players — a spell summons it on cast.
Damage and speed come from the spell, not from the item.
mmorpg.item.desc.projectile.snowball:
A service projectile of the water school.
Never given to players — a spell summons it on cast.
Damage and speed come from the spell, not from the item.
mmorpg.item.desc.projectile.slimeball:
A service projectile of the nature school.
Never given to players — a spell summons it on cast.
Damage and speed come from the spell, not from the item.
mmorpg.item.desc.scroll.paper:
An inscription material.
Used to craft scrolls together with the scribe's tool.
Crafted from paper, string and two tier 1 purified essences.
mmorpg.item.desc.misc.teleport_back:
Right click and hold to return to the entrance.
Only works inside dungeons and maps, useless in the normal world.
Single use.
mmorpg.item.desc.loot_table_chest:
Right click to open a reward chest.
The contents come from the loot table attached to the item.
Single use.
mmorpg.item.desc.full_favor:
Right click to gain 1000 favor.
Favor is spent on NPC services and goods.
Made from an empty vessel of favor.
mmorpg.item.desc.empty_favor:
Right click to fill the vessel.
Takes 1000 favor and turns into a full vessel.
Requires level 20 and at least 1000 favor.
mmorpg.item.desc.custom_crate:
A crate with gear of a chosen rarity.
Right click to open.
The crate itself sets the rarity and tier.
mmorpg.item.desc.newbie_gear_bag:
Right click to get a starter gear set.
The set is picked for your chosen class.
Given to new players on their first join.
mmorpg.item.desc.salvage_hammer:
A salvaging tool.
Pick the hammer up with the cursor and click a piece of gear in your inventory to salvage it into essence.
The hammer is not consumed.
It does not salvage named or enchanted items.
mmorpg.item.desc.socket_extractor:
A gem extractor.
Pick it up with the cursor and click socketed gear — the first gem returns to your inventory.
The socket is freed and the extractor is not consumed.
The item must have at least one socketed gem.
mmorpg.item.desc.mat.infused_iron:
A currency crafting material.
Used in the Orb of Chaos recipe, which rerolls all affixes.
Also counts as a profession material.
mmorpg.item.desc.mat.crystallized_essenc:
A currency crafting material.
Used in the Orb of Blessing and Orb of Turbulence recipes.
Also counts as a profession material.
mmorpg.item.desc.mat.golden_orb:
A currency crafting material.
Needed for the Leaf of Change, Orb of Unique Blessing, Orb of Corruption and Orb of Infinity.
Also counts as a profession material.
mmorpg.item.desc.mat.mythic_essence:
A currency crafting material.
Needed for the Orb of Corruption and Orb of Infinity.
Also counts as a profession material.
mmorpg.item.desc.potions.reset_all_perks:
Right click to drink: resets all talents.
Spent talent points are refunded.
Leaves an empty bottle.
mmorpg.item.desc.potions.add_reset_perk_:
Right click to drink: +5 talent reset points.
A reset point removes one talent without losing the rest.
Leaves an empty bottle.
mmorpg.item.desc.potions.reset_spells:
Right click to drink: resets all learned spells.
Frees up your spell slots.
Leaves an empty bottle.
mmorpg.item.desc.potions.reset_stats:
Right click to drink: resets your allocated stat points.
The points are refunded.
Leaves an empty bottle.
mmorpg.item.desc.potions.death_potion:
Right click to drink... and find out.
Kills whoever drinks it. Not recommended in hardcore.
It is a joke, not a medicine.
mmorpg.item.desc.backpack.normal:
An adventurer's backpack.
Right click to open its inventory.
Upgrades (auto pickup, auto salvage) are installed by dragging them onto the backpack.
Items picked up by upgrades go straight inside.
mmorpg.item.desc.backpack.material_pouch:
A pouch for profession materials.
Right click to open.
It stores ingredients, essences and stones.
mmorpg.item.desc.teleporter:
A teleporter block.
Place it and right click to open the adventure map.
It is used to pick a map and travel into a dungeon.
mmorpg.item.desc.runeword_station:
The Runeword Station.
Place the block and right click it.
Put in an item and the complete rune set from a recipe — the item gains that runeword.
mmorpg.item.desc.portal:
A portal into an adventure.
Created by the game when entering a map or dungeon.
Stepping into it takes you to the chosen adventure.
Normally not placed by hand.
mmorpg.item.desc.family.gear:
Gear.
Worn in its own slot: helmet, chestplate, leggings, boots, weapon, ring or amulet.
Stats are generated on drop: the higher the tier and rarity, the more and the stronger they are.
The tooltip lists the level and stat requirements together with whether you meet them.
Durability is repaired with purified essence, the item is salvaged with a salvage hammer, and currency changes its rarity and sockets.
mmorpg.item.desc.rarity.essence.base:
A rarity essence.
Right click to combine 9 such essences into a rarity upgrade stone.
Can be salvaged with a hammer into Source of Strength.
The essence rarity decides which gear rarity the stone works on.
mmorpg.item.desc.rarity.upgrade_stone.ba:
A rarity upgrade stone.
How to use: drag it onto a piece of gear in your inventory.
Raises the item rarity by one step.
Requirement: the item's upgrade level must be at least the value listed on the stone.
mmorpg.item.desc.family.dungeon_key:
An Infinite Dungeons key.
Right click to pick a dungeon and difficulty, then press Start.
The dungeon is built above you: you need open sky and a dimension without a ceiling.
The key is consumed on start.
Drops rarely from hostile mobs.
mmorpg.item.desc.family.dungeon_coin:
An Infinite Dungeons coin.
The dungeon shop currency: after clearing a dungeon, right click the trader villager.
Coins buy reward crates and gear.
Each shop takes its own coin: skeletal is the lowest tier, nether the middle one, void the highest.
Drops from mobs inside dungeons.
mmorpg.item.desc.infinite_dungeons.rewar:
An Infinite Dungeons reward crate.
Right click to open: it gives one random reward from its own list.
The name tells you what is inside, some crates can hit a jackpot.
Bought in the dungeon shop for coins.
mmorpg.item.desc.divine_missions.mission:
A god's mission.
Right click to hand in the items the mission asks for; once everything is collected it completes and pays out.
The mission has a time limit: if you run out, it disappears.
Missions are given at the shrine.
mmorpg.item.desc.divine_missions.shrine:
A god's shrine.
Place the block and right click it to open the mission menu.
This is where you take missions and track them.
mmorpg.item.desc.ingredient.bone_figurin:
The Bone Figurine works through its position in the crafting grid, not on its own.
Professions: jewel crafting, armor crafting, weapon crafting.
Ingredients that do NOT touch it get +10% effectiveness.
Ingredients touching it on a side (up, down, left, right) get -25% effectiveness.
The grid is 3x2: in a corner the figurine touches only two slots, so place it in a corner and keep your strong ingredients away from it.
The figurine itself gives the item no stats — only this neighbour effect.
mmorpg.item.desc.ingredient.blackpearl:
The Black Pearl is a positional ingredient.
Professions: jewel crafting, alchemy.
It adds critical damage to the item.
Ingredients touching it on a side lose 20% effectiveness — place it in a corner of the 3x2 grid.
mmorpg.item.desc.ingredient.enigma_stone:
The Enigma Stone is a positional ingredient.
Professions: jewel crafting, weapon crafting, alchemy.
It adds spell critical damage and spell critical chance (the range is shown in the tooltip).
Ingredients touching it on a side lose 25% effectiveness — place it in a corner of the 3x2 grid.
mmorpg.item.desc.ingredient.rock_jade:
Rock Jade is an artifact positional ingredient.
Professions: all of them (jewel crafting, armor crafting, weapon crafting, alchemy, cooking, inscription).
It adds a random stat and raises the minimum rarity of the result.
Downsides: crafting success chance -10%, and ingredients touching it lose 20% effectiveness.
Because of "Only one of", you cannot add a second artifact to the same craft.
mmorpg.item.desc.ingredient.endergem:
Endergem is an artifact positional ingredient.
Professions: all of them (jewel crafting, armor crafting, weapon crafting, alchemy, cooking, inscription).
It adds 2 random stats and raises the minimum rarity of the result.
Downsides: crafting success chance -25%, ingredients touching it lose 20% effectiveness.
Artifact: only one such ingredient per craft.
mmorpg.item.desc.ingredient.wishing_bowl:
The Wishing Bowl is an artifact ingredient.
Professions: jewel crafting, armor crafting.
It raises the minimum rarity of the crafted gear by 1.
Artifact: only one such ingredient per craft.
It does not affect neighbouring slots.
mmorpg.item.desc.ingredient.pot_of_greed:
The Pot of Greed is an artifact ingredient.
Professions: alchemy, cooking, inscription.
It grants +2 to the maximum uses of the crafted consumable (food, potion, scroll).
Artifact: only one such ingredient per craft.
It does not affect neighbouring slots.
mmorpg.item.desc.ingredient.soul_matrix:
The Soul Matrix is an artifact ingredient.
Professions: all six.
It raises the crafting success chance by 20% — handy together with ingredients that lower it.
Artifact: only one such ingredient per craft.
It does not affect neighbouring slots.
